# MP0004

Optional policy restricting direct System.Console calls in projects that require structured logging.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Category | Usage |
| Default severity | Disabled |
| Availability | Public analyzer package |

This rule is disabled by default. Set an explicit severity to opt in.

## Configure severity

```ini title=".editorconfig"
dotnet_diagnostic.MP0004.severity = warning
```

Use `none` to disable the rule, or `silent`, `suggestion`, `warning`, or `error` to change its severity.

## Suppress a specific occurrence

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MP0004
// Code that intentionally violates MP0004.
#pragma warning restore MP0004
```
